Seoul (서울특별시) — 韓國旅遊指南：必去景點、交通方式與在地美食

Gyeongbokgung & Bukchon Hanok Village, Myeongdong, Hongdae & Seongsu-dong, N Seoul Tower & Cheonggyecheon, Insadong & Dongdaemun DDP. AREX Airport Railroad from Incheon (ICN) & Gimpo (GMP); 9+ subway lines and KTX hub at Seoul Station & Yongsan.

所屬地區 / 州份Seoul (서울특별시)
主要交通樞紐Seoul Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)
所有城市與市鎮562

交通方式與當地移動

AREX Airport Railroad from Incheon (ICN) & Gimpo (GMP); 9+ subway lines and KTX hub at Seoul Station & Yongsan.

在地美食與特產

  • Korean BBQ
  • Gwangjang Market bindaetteok
  • Michelin & pojangmacha dining
  • Chimaek (fried chicken & beer)
  • Royal court cuisine
